SB ARES @ WWW
From: KJ4WXA
Subj: Winlink exercise Sat Nov 21

All district stations,
The quarterly Winlink exercise is this Saturday 1300-1500 EST (1800-2000Z). Scenario is a winter ice storm with widespread power loss.
- Send one ICS-213 to KJ4WXA with your station status (power source, modes available, battery hours).
- Use RF only, no telnet.
- Bonus: send a second msg via a gateway more than 200 mi away.
Target: 40 stations. Last quarter we had 27.
Questions on the Tues net, 3.937. Results will be posted by Dec 1 with a list of who got through on which band.

Subj: BPQ node config tip
